input.product_description: ClearGuard is a clean beauty sunscreen designed for sensitive skin. Formulated with gentle, non-toxic ingredients, it provides broad-spectrum protection without irritating your skin. Perfect for skincare-conscious women and men in their 20s and 30s seeking comfort and peace of mind in their daily sun protection routine.
input.target_group: Skincare-conscious women and men in their 20s and 30s with sensitive skin

marketing_strategy.main_insight: Customers express a strong preference for ClearGuard's gentle, non-toxic ingredients and broad-spectrum protection, but are hesitant about the price point and need reassurance regarding product effectiveness and scientific backing.
customer_pain_points: Lack of scientific evidence and product effectiveness
marketing_strategy.marketing_direction: Focus on building trust and addressing price concerns through targeted messaging and promotions.
marketing_strategy.message_strategy: Highlight the scientific backing of the ingredients, showcase testimonials from active individuals, and offer a discount for first-time buyers.
risk_to_avoid: Not addressing customer skepticism about 'clean beauty' sunscreen claims

sns_content.post_title: ClearGuard: Your Safe & Gentle Sunscreen Solution!
sns_content.main_copy: Experience the perfect balance of protection and comfort with ClearGuard. Our scientifically-backed, non-toxic formula ensures broad-spectrum protection without compromising on your skin's well-being. Perfect for sensitive skin and trusted by sun-seekers worldwide. Don't let the price concern you - feel the difference with our special offer for first-time buyers!
sns_content.short_hook: ClearGuard: Gentle, Effective, & Now More Affordable!
sns_content.image_prompt_for_sdxl: Generate an image showcasing a person enjoying outdoor activities under the sun, with ClearGuard sunscreen applied, highlighting the product's gentle and effective formula.
sns_content.negative_prompt_for_sdxl: Avoid showing close-ups of the product alone; focus on the user experience and outdoor setting.
